message: 大賢者覚醒

name: Synn
message: 「You raging bull!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Watch out, Synn-sama!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqyyyyyyyy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! Paqy!」
He's so torn up that describing it would get this banned on the spot!

name: Paqy
message: 「Pipe down... I can't get any sleep with you yelling right in my ear like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't go to sleep!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's time to give up. If I were human, I'd be long dead by now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hang in there! I'll sew you right up!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's no use, doing that won't fix me when I'm this wrecked...」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh. Classic Demon Lord. Pretending to worry about your underling to move me to tears so I'll work hard enough to throw my life away when it counts.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't thinking anything like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph. Yeah, right. You wouldn't think of something like that, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't there anything we can do!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't make that face.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you had a spare plushie or something, I could just transfer my soul into that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「All you'd have to do is press the plushie against yours truly and chant, 'Tekuteku Mayamaya Makumaku Konkon, become my substitute'」

name: Synn
message: 「So all I need is a plushie!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't push yourself. I know there's nothing that fancy in this Grand Palace Sakura.」
I could win one at the arcade in front of the station!
No, wait, I don't have the money!
Besides, even if they had one, going all the way there and back wouldn't make it in time!

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it! For now, into a pillow!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ain't gonna work unless it's shaped like a livin' creature... Ah, my eyes are startin' to go dark...」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! Don't you have a spare body or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Heh. Wasn't all that bad of a life...」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy!」
Isn't there anything I can do!?

name: Synn
message: 「That's it! Maybe there's something in the box Paqy came in!」
I figured the box might come in handy later, so I should've stashed it in the closet!

name: Synn
message: 「Found it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! There's a plushie at the bottom of the box!」
It looks just like Paqy, though it's giving off a seriously dazzling aura.
I've got a bad feeling about this... Oh, there's a note right here!

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama... I know you're gonna become an awesome Demon Lord who rivals even the very first...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Talk about total last-words dialogue!?」
There's no time to hesitate or read notes!

name: Synn
message: 「It's Tekuteku Mayamaya Makumaku Konkon, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah... That Lumiel's gettin' pissed... More light... *thud*」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! I'll save you right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Tekuteku Mayamaya Makumaku Konkon, become a substitute!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」
Was I too late!?

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy... If only I hadn't messed up...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hnn... Where am I...」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama! That means...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm back in action!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness...」

name: Paqy
message: 「O-Oh! It's like I've been reborn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「My power from back when I was the Great Sage is coming back! No, it might be even greater than before!」
Some kind of amazing aura is coming off Paqy's body!

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... The way I am now, the Seven Demon Generals are nothing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I could even go toe-to-toe with Re-Crea!」

name: Paqy
message: 「With this... I can even have the Demon Lord all to myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What was that just now? For a second, my consciousness felt...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calling myself 'the great me' is so barbaric! The Demon Lord will hate me if I act like a tomboy. I don't want that!」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy? Is something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way... T-This is the Evil Body!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Evil Body?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The immortal, invincible ultimate body I created back when I was the Great Sage, mobilizing every bit of knowledge I possessed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, truly, what a wonderful body! Calling it evil is just mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Split personality!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama... Eliminate me... There's still time...」

name: Paqy
message: 「How cruel, Demon Lord! Wanting to eliminate me! That's just too awful!」
This feels really bad!
Right, there's something on the note!

name: Synn
message: 「'Do Not Use'... That's all it says!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah... My consciousness...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm starting to feel kinda feminine, man.」

name: Synn
message: 「F-Feminine?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ufu. Aah, this feels great... It's been so long since I felt this delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Delicious!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama... you're so cool.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Who are you!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's so mean! Forgetting the face of your little sister who's been with you forever and ever!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think it's even been two months, though... wait, little sister!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama is so wonderful.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aha. Even though I'm your little sister, calling you Synn-sama is weird, isn't it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「From now on, I'll call you Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No good? Big Brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that it's no good, but... n-no, it's definitely no good!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why? Why is it no good, Big Brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm an only child!」

name: Paqy
message: 「They made you believe that, didn't they, Big Brother. But it's okay. From now on, it'll just be the two of us forever.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll never let you feel lonely again, Big Brother!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll give you all of my body and soul, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you suddenly pushing me down!」
Even though I'm the same size as Paqy, I can't push her off!

name: Paqy
message: 「Because I wanted you to know how I feel about you, Big Brother...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't have to be scared, Big Brother. I'll do everything for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't pull down my zipper! H-Heeeelp.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I was so happy... Now I've given you everything, Big Brother--my body, my soul, my front, my back, and my mouth.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sniffle... E-Even though it was my first time...」
To think I'd end up in this kind of relationship with Paqy....

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk-bawk!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami!」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-doo.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aha! So you're Big Brother's mistress?! 'Give Big Brother back,' you say?!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat?! I really don't think Sasami is saying that...」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-doo! Bawk-bawk!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What did you say?! You're carrying Big Brother's baby in your belly?!」

name: Synn
message: 「First of all, Sasami is a guy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll never hand Big Brother over to you!」
Sasami was obliterated in a manner so brutal that describing it would get this banned immediately!

name: Paqy
message: 「What a liar. There's nobody inside at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sasami! Sasami!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I won't forgive any other woman making eyes at Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! I won't let you do anything else to my companions!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forbidden Spell: Binding Chains!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can't move... W-What did you do!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's okay, Big Brother. You seem confused by all sorts of things right now, but if you just leave everything to me, it'll all work out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's it! I just have to wipe out every single girl who might make eyes at Big Brother!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So this is those women's campus.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, ruuuuuun!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forbidden Spell: Meteor!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaaah.」

name: Synn
message: 「The academyyyyyyyy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Looks like a few of them managed to get away.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I won't let you get away!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Disappear along with the whole world!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ultimate Magic!」
And so, the world perished.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... what happened to me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, thank goodness, Big Brother, you finally woke up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where is this...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Eternal World.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thank goodness... I'm so glad...」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I went a little overboard and ended up pulverizing your body too, Big Brother. Tehee.」

name: Paqy
message: 「But I transferred your soul into a pillow beforehand, Big Brother, so it's totally fine.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wiped out Re-Crea while I was at it, too, so there's no one left to get in our way now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe. Big Brother... we'll be together forever, won't we.」
